result.transcript:
Agent: Hello, this is City Clinic calling for John Doe.
Patient: Speaking.
Agent: Hi John, calling about your appointment Monday 17 Aug at 10:00 AM. Are you still able to attend?
Patient: Actually no, something came up at work.
Agent: No problem. We have Thursday 20 Aug at 2:30 PM available. Would that work?
Patient: Yes, that works perfectly.
Agent: Great, I've noted that down. See you Thursday!

evidence: Patient requested reschedule to Thursday 20 Aug at 2:30 PM

activity.message: Patient unable to attend original slot
Patient confirmed Thursday 20 Aug at 2:30 PM
